description: Hand-reviewed corrections to the canonical client list produced by the two AI classification passes. These are human decisions, not model output: they override whatever canonical_name the model assigned to the listed raw folder names. Applied mechanically by the client-list build so they survive any re-run of the pipeline.
matching: raw_names are matched on the normalized key produced by normalizeName() in scripts/grants-lib.mjs (trim, strip trailing whitespace and .,;:_-*, collapse internal whitespace, lowercase). The strings below are the folder names exactly as they appear in Dropbox.

corrections.note: The model split these across two canonical companies ('Level Ground' and 'Level Ground Trading'). One company.
